target_year_over_year_context.explanation: Both disclosures discuss gains/losses on equity investments. D078 (2023) focuses on mark-to-market adjustments driven by the non-marketable investment in Montage Technology. D093 (2024) defines the components of unrealized gains/losses on non-marketable investments (observable price adjustments, equity method gains), which is the accounting mechanism for investments like Montage. D094 focuses on realized gains from sales, making D093 the better structural counterpart for D078's unrealized nature.

comparisons.peer_summary: Other, net, consists of realized or unrealized gains and losses from investments in non-affiliated entities and the impact of changes in foreign currency rates. The change in Other, net compared to fiscal year 2023 was driven by changes in value from non-affiliated investments.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and NVIDIA define unrealized gains on non-marketable investments as part of their other income/expense composition, specifically citing changes in value from investments in non-affiliated entities as a key driver. Intel explicitly includes 'observable price adjustments' and 'share of equity method investee gains' in its definition, while NVIDIA's disclosure aligns by stating that changes in Other, net were 'driven by changes in value from our non-affiliated investments,' indicating a shared reliance on valuation changes of equity stakes for financial performance reporting in this line item.
